a11y.apg: Layout primitive, no role and no keyboard: it is a <div> with CSS grid. Deliberately NOT role="grid" — that is the ARIA pattern for a data grid with cell navigation, which is DataGrid. Same word, different thing.

props.name: children
props.description: Responsive columns with no breakpoints: each one is at least --grid-min wide (15rem by default) and they fill the row, with --space-4 between them.

props.name: gap
props.description: Three steps and no others (ADR-0051): tight is --space-2, normal is --space-4, loose is --space-6. The old rule still holds against ANY spacing; these two extra steps exist for the two measured cases — a note under its value, and a grid of filters.

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum column width, as a CSS length ("10rem", "155px"). It is the --grid-min the CSS always read and no type exposed.

props.name: columns
props.description: A fixed number of equal columns. With it, `min` stops applying.

props.name: className
props.description: Where you set --grid-min for a denser or a wider grid. That variable is the adjustment knob, the same idea as --qr-size on QRCode: a column count as a prop would freeze a number that the container is the one who knows.
